new.s: Which body in Andhra Pradesh, set up in 2000, mobilises the rural poor into women's self-help groups and livelihoods?
new.x: The Society for Elimination of Rural Poverty (SERP), set up in 2000, works with the rural poor; MEPMA works in municipal (urban) areas.

new.s: Which of the following Millennium Development Goal targets did India meet by 2015?
new.x: India met the MDG 1 target of halving extreme poverty by 2015 but missed the maternal health, hunger and sanitation targets.

new.x: Under the updated Rangarajan line, Chhattisgarh was highest (rural 25.1%, urban 13.3%).

new.s: Who propounded the theory of surplus value?
new.x: The theory of surplus value is from Karl Marx (Das Kapital); Ricardo gave the theory of rent and comparative advantage.

new.s: In 2023-24, the median income of the top 10% in India was about how many times that of the bottom 10%?

new.s: What is the Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR)?
o: Employed persons as a share of the total population
Labour force as a share of the working-age population
Unemployed persons as a share of the labour force
Unemployed persons as a share of the total population
new.x: LFPR is the labour force (employed + unemployed) per 100 of the working-age population.

new.s: Which of the following persons are outside the labour force?

Students and homemakers not seeking work

new.s: Before the January 2025 revamp, for which areas did PLFS give quarterly estimates?

new.s: What does the term 'jobless growth' mean?

Growth in which unemployment of labour increases even at the height of economic growth
Growth of the agricultural sector alone
new.x: Jobless growth means the economy grows but unemployment rises, as employment elasticity is near zero.
